container-queries.headline: Components that respond to their own space.
container-queries.explanation: Container queries let a component adapt to its available width instead of relying on the viewport.
container-queries.demoTitle: A little room for good ideas.
container-queries.demoDescription: A comfortable corner. A fresh perspective. Somewhere to stay curious.

fluid-type.headline: A little space. A different scale.
fluid-type.explanation: Container units and clamp() let type grow with its surroundings while keeping a comfortable minimum and maximum size. Resize the card to see its headline scale.
fluid-type.demoTitle: Good ideas grow with a little room.
fluid-type.demoDescription: A comfortable corner. A fresh perspective. Somewhere to stay curious.

aspect-ratio.headline: Give every image room to belong.
aspect-ratio.explanation: Aspect-ratio gives an image a predictable frame. Here, a container query changes that frame from a wide view to a square as the card gains space.
aspect-ratio.demoDescription: A comfortable corner. A fresh perspective. Somewhere to stay curious.
